_doc: UART pin selection patterns and SoC data. A pin is UART only when the workbook's SELECTED function says so (UART_QUPn / HSUART_QUPn ...); the 'interfaces' capability list is never used. For a QUP UART the pinctrl function is the same `qupN` the SPI engine uses, so the pin tables are READ FROM spi_profiles.json (Linux pinctrl driver of the SoC) and not copied. 'controller_defined' lists the UART controller numbers that the SoC's mainline dtsi really defines; any other UART number gets a controller label that is marked as a guess.

SA8155P.source: pin table and QUP wrappers: spi_profiles.json (Linux v6.6 pinctrl-sm8150.c / sm8150.dtsi); UART controllers defined in mainline sm8150.dtsi: uart2, uart9
